name: NanoAvionics

overview.value: NanoAvionics is a small satellite bus manufacturer and mission integrator headquartered in Lithuania, founded in 2014. The company builds nanosatellite buses and integrates commercial and scientific satellite missions, and has implemented over 150 successful commercial missions with customers in more than 50 countries. Kongsberg Gruppen holds a 77 percent majority stake, with company management retaining the remainder.

focus.value: Small satellite bus manufacturer and mission integrator

notes: Added in the registry self-pop batch B (2026-09-09). Majority owned by Kongsberg Gruppen (Nasdaq listed parent); NanoAvionics itself carries no separate ticker.
